verdict.rationale: An API reference with runnable examples is a fair thing to ask of a hosted agent service, so the axis applies. However, the runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API: the OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai belongs to the separate xAI model API and has zero grok-bot paths. Grok Bot is driven only through its own desktop and mobile apps, and there is no evidence of an interactive or runnable API reference.
